source: Ticket 820 (PK1, spec #647), the GD lock of 24 Oct 15:22 with its final lock ~15:30 and the Systems rows for the locked HS kits: a tool costs 1·R(g_home)·paceScale(g_home) at every merchant, no markup; a consumable is priced at the buyer's g from its runValueShare of R (Cache Crate 0.1·R(1), Damp Flask 0.2·R(3), the TD ruling on #823: the crate is sold on P1 only, so the two readings coincide) with a carry limit of 3; the trader premium is +25% on the planet's own ores, once per ore, never stacked with the assay beacon's lift (a sale gets the larger of the two). awayMarkup is Systems' fallback only, recorded and not applied. R(g) is runValueOf in jumpFuel.ts and paceScale is planetEconomy.ts's; #681 rounds every price up. containers is the TD's final ruling on #823 (comment 6384924632, points 1 and 5): a placed container's cap per kind, per player and per planet (cache_crate 3, flat, no global cap) and the access a new container is placed with (owner; crew sharing is a later data flip). heldFromSale is the GD's ship rule on #850 (25 Oct, the split into #881 and #882): the four hazard tools were listed and bought nowhere until T2 (#882) landed their visible verbs; T2 emptied the list, and the flag stays in data for any later kit item that ships before its verb. acting is T1's (ticket 881; #850's rows, the GD lock 6395054734 and the TD's seams): while a tool acts, its hazard's contact factor (scree_plough refill -50%, shard_tongs bite -60%, vent_vane shove -60%) and its trade-off on the track its row's tradeOff.costs names (thrust -10% floor 9000 bp, cut speed -25% floor 7500 bp, horizontal speed -30% floor 7000 bp, #850 body). A tool acts while its hazard kind is at the rig's cell or within the drill's reach, and tailTicks (G&V's 0.5 s hysteresis, 30 ticks at 60/s) after it was last seen; the tail counts as acting (VS). The flask is uncorked on purpose: its kind's drain factor is factorBp (-100%) for openTicks (60 s) from the uncork. The outcomes are T2's (ticket 882; the GD's final lock on #850 6395059392, Systems' rows 6395065669 and the vane correction 6395074595), one visible verb per tool while it acts, fixed and never scaled by planet or g: shove_aside moves the intact scree cell ahead of the drill sideTiles (1) to the side, the facing's left before its right, into the first open cell, through the terrain edit queue, and shoves nothing with neither side open; loot drops the spinecrystal cluster the drill breaks as loot at the cell's normal yield, no shatter loss and no new item; aim_outward turns the vent's shove outward from the core at the vaned size (shoveTiles x the factor, no liftBp), so a vaned rig never climbs faster than a bare one. The flask clears its kind's hazard flag within clearRadiusTiles (2, Euclidean by cell centre) of the rig's cell at the uncork for its window, deleting no cell.
